measurement_contract.compile: Fresh compiler process: source-to-finalized JIT for JOAN; source-to-executable for C, C++, and Rust.
measurement_contract.inner_runtime: Dynamic input generation, enum dispatch, bounded checked kernel call, fuel accounting, and checksum; excludes compilation and JSON.
measurement_contract.peak_rss: Peak resident bytes for the complete fresh process; not generated-code-only memory.
measurement_contract.process_time: JOAN and Julia include source compilation; C, C++, and Rust execute prepared artifacts, so this field is not cross-lifecycle comparable.
